question_text: Without writing code, describe a procedure to store24 hourly readings in parallel lists hours and readings so that each time is clearly associated with its measurement.
adaptation_rationale: Retains no-code parallel-list procedure and algorithmic design; no spreadsheet implementation required.
solution: Create two lists with 24 corresponding positions. For each index 0..23, store that hour in hours[index] and its measured value in readings[index]. Process all 24 indices and keep the same ordering in both lists so index i links the time and reading.

marking_points.criterion: Stores each measurement at matching index.
